model_assumptions.floor_count: Three visible levels interpreted from official operator exterior photographs; estimated, not independently documented in an elevation drawing.
model_assumptions.height_status: Estimated from three visible levels, not a measured elevation.
model_assumptions.roof: Simple flat roof/parapet; rooftop plant and fine roof geometry not visible in available imagery.
model_assumptions.entrance: Stone portal and dark canopy included; exact side and location are not georeferenced and remain approximate.
model_assumptions.facade: Broad siding, brick, stone, dark fascia, and glazed areas follow official gallery photographs; detailed dimensions and orientation remain unverified.
model_assumptions.placement: Keeps the source OSM ring in the repository campus coordinate frame; no campus relocation made.
